pages.title: Sniff
pages.text: Sniff is the song for Chicago, the tenth race in Skitchin'. At 8.9 miles, Chicago ties with New York as the longest race, twice the length of Denver. The password is PIZZA.

pages.title: Bonus tracks
pages.text: If you race well in Skitchin', a local skater invites you to their own bonus track. It might be a Speed Course, a Trick Track, an Obstacle Course or a Chase Course. In King of the Bus, the goal is to be the last one still skitching.

pages.title: Your 26 rivals
pages.text: In Skitchin', 26 rivals race against you for the prize money. Among them are Fester, Jezebel, Karcass, Thrasher, Pickle, Splink, Pimple, Noxious and Dan Grr.
